name: Shirokuma Cafe
description: Pushed by his mother to stop lazing around the house, a Panda searches for a part-time job but has troubling finding one to accommodate his laziness. He soon stumbles upon the Shirokuma Cafe, run by a Polar Bear who is holding interviews for a part-time position with his faithful customer Penguin. Panda applies for the job but fails the interview, with the job instead going to a human girl named Sasako. However, the others soon point Panda towards a part-time job at a nearby zoo.

episodes.name: Polar Bears Caféye hoş geldiniz
episodes.description: Annesi tarafından evin etrafında tembellik etmeyi bırakmaya zorlanan Panda, yarı zamanlı bir iş arar, ancak tembelliğini karşılayacak birini bulmakta zorlanır. Kısa süre sonra, sadık müşterisi Penguin ile yarı zamanlı bir pozisyon için röportajlar yapan bir Polar Bear tarafından yönetilen Polar Bear Caféye rastlar.

episodes.name: Panda-kunun İstihdamı
episodes.description: Penguen, Pandayı tam zamanlı eğlenceli okul çocuklarıyla birlikte çalıştığı evcil hayvan çiftliğinde yarı zamanlı bir işe yönlendirir.

episodes.name: Herkesin Kafe
episodes.description: Panda, Penguin ve Lama, kendi kafelerini işletip işletmediklerine dair fikir üretirler.

episodes.name: Kafenin Çiçek İzleme Partisi
episodes.description: Herkes, Penguinin çok sarhoş olduğu bir çiçek izleme partisine gider ve sevdiği bir penguen için devam eder.

episodes.name: Hayvanat Bahçesinde Kutup Ayısı
episodes.description: Kutup Ayısı ve Penguen, Pandanın çalıştığı hayvanat bahçesine gelir. Pandayı uyanıkken yakalamakta ve diğer turistik yerleri ziyaret etmekte zorlanırlar.

episodes.name: Pandanın Acısı
episodes.description: Panda ve diğer hayvanlar işlerini yaparken karşılaştıkları sorunları tartışırlar.

episodes.name: Akıllı Telefonlara Takıntılı
episodes.description: Panda, akıllı telefonu olan herkesi gördükten sonra annesini ona bir tane almaya ikna eder, ancak kısa süre sonra onun sahip olduğu panda kılıfını kırar. Kutup Ayısı, sadece gerçek telefonu kırmayı bitirmesi için ona bir origami panda kılıfı yaparak Pandayı neşelendirir.

episodes.name: Süper Eğlenceli Sürüş Dersi
episodes.description: Bazı sürüş tekniklerini öğrenmek isteyen Penguin, bir sürüşte Kutup Ayısı ve Pandaya katılır.

episodes.name: Panda Hevesli Oluyor
episodes.description: Panda, bir hafta boyunca tam zamanlı pandayı doldurmak zorunda olduğundan, iş için dolu trenlere binmek zorunda kalır. Rin-Rin adındaki sözde bir hayranından çiçek almaya başladığında neşeleniyor ve daha enerjik hale geliyor, ancak daha sonra bunun erkek çiçekçi dükkanı sahibi Rintaro Hayashi olduğunu öğreniyor.

episodes.name: Herkesin Parfesi
episodes.description: Kutup Ayısı bir parfe fuarı yapmaya karar verir ve servis için bazı özel parfe bulmaya çalışır.

episodes.name: Pandanın Diyeti
episodes.description: İşteki bir olayın ardından Panda aşırı kilolu olduğunu hisseder ve diyet yapmaya karar verir.

episodes.name: Bunun için çabalayın! Vahşi panda
episodes.description: Panda, vahşi tarafıyla temasa geçmesi gerektiğine karar verir, bu yüzden Kutup Ayısı onu bar işleten çocukluk arkadaşı Grizzly ile tanışmaya götürür.

episodes.name: Bay Handanın Yeniden Modelleme Planı
episodes.description: Daha popüler olmayı başarabileceğini hisseden Panda, Handaya bir makyaj yapmaya karar verir, ancak her şey Handanın ödediği bir güne dönüşür.

episodes.name: Büyük Aşk Aşk Sürüş Operasyonu
episodes.description: Ehliyetini alan Penguin, flört ehliyetini almak için Polar Bear tarafından test edilir.

episodes.name: Bir Dergi Röportajı Geliyor
episodes.description: Kutup Ayısı, bir Shoebill olan editörün başını çektiği bir dergide kafesi hakkında röportaj yapıyor.

episodes.name: Somon Avcısı: Bay Grizzly
episodes.description: Panda, bazı malzemeleri toplamak için Kutup Ayısı ve Grizzlyye katılır.

episodes.name: Rin Rin Derinden Harekete Geçti! Pandanın Evi!
episodes.description: Rintaro, Pandanın evine teslimat yapıp ailesiyle tanıştığı zaman heyecanlanır.

episodes.name: Bay Penguinin İtirafı
episodes.description: Diğerleri, Penkoya itiraf etme cesaretini toplamaya çalışırken Penguini desteklemeye çalışır.

episodes.name: Bay Handanın kör randevusu?
episodes.description: Pandanın müdahalesi sayesinde Handa, arkadaşı Kirino tarafından bazı kızlarla tanışmak için miksere gitmek üzere tuzağa düşürülür.

episodes.name: Bay Handanın Kör Randevusu!
episodes.description: Adamlardan biri iptal ettiğinde, Panda ve Kutup Ayısı, adamın tarafını doldurur. Ancak kızlar, Handadan çok Pandaya ilgi duymaya başlarlar.

episodes.name: Mr. Penguin's Broken Heart
episodes.description: Penguin gets heartbroken when he assumes Penko is dating Tortoise.

episodes.name: Panda's Night Out
episodes.description: Panda joins Polar Bear and Grizzly on a night out, visiting a batting center and a public bath.

episodes.name: Panda, Tired of Boredom
episodes.description: Panda and the Full-time Panda attempt to distract themselves during a boring and rainy day at the zoo, much to Handa's chagrin.

episodes.name: Panda'nın Sorunlar İçin Danışma Odası
episodes.description: Handa bir kez daha aşk hayatını sorgular ama Kutup Ayısı Kafe'ye ilk ziyaretinde biraz huzur bulur.

episodes.name: Tanabata Decorations
episodes.description: As the café prepares for a Tanabata party, everyone has trouble deciding what they should wish for.

episodes.name: Panda's Wish
episodes.description: Noticing Handa seems to have a crush on Sasako, Panda tries to help him work up his confidence.

episodes.name: Enthusiastic Polar Bear
episodes.description: As Panda laments having nothing to due whilst Polar Bear wishes he had more free time, Polar Bear takes Panda's place at the zoo pretending to be a panda, proving to be a hit.

episodes.name: Let's Go to the Beach!
episodes.description: Polar Bear, Panda and Penguin take a trip to the beach.

episodes.name: Weeding in the Summer
episodes.description: The backyard of the Polar Bear's Café needs weeding, but Penguin seems to be the only one taking things seriously.

episodes.name: Bay Penguenin Romantizmi
episodes.description: Penguen sonunda cesaretini toplayarak Penkoya bir hafta boyunca her gün çıkma teklif eder. Ancak, yanlışlıkla yedi özdeş kız pengueni sorduğu ortaya çıktı ve hepsi aynı gün ortaya çıktığında felakete yol açtı.

episodes.name: Mr. Grizzly Goes On an Adventure
episodes.description: As the café starts serving a shaved ice dessert called "Polar Bear", Grizzly gets the wrong idea and believes Polar Bear had been eaten by otters.

episodes.name: A Strange Restaurant
episodes.description: A salaryman from another town arrives at the Polar Bear's Café for the first time and is astounded by the various customers.

episodes.name: Let's Go Camping!
episodes.description: Polar Bear, Panda, Penguin and Grizzly go on a camping trip together, where Penguin and Grizzly find they have a lot in common whilst trying to keep Polar Bear and Panda in check.

episodes.name: Rin Rin and the High School Girl
episodes.description: A high school girl is asked by Rintarou to accompany him to the zoo, believing it to be a date, only to find he just wanted someone to talk about how cute Panda is.

episodes.name: The Cafe's Ghost Stories
episodes.description: The café decides to hold a night of telling ghost stories, much to an easily-frighted Handa's dismay.

episodes.name: Penguenlerin Birçok Çeşitleri Vardır
episodes.description: Penguen yeğeniyle birlikte çeteye katılırken, kolayca sinirlenen kral penguen ve Penko kardeşlerle uğraşmak zorunda kalır.

episodes.name: Baisen Nedir!?
episodes.description: Polar Bears Café markasının sade kahvenin tadına hayran kalan Misaki adında bir adam, kahve çekirdeklerini nasıl kavuracağını öğrenmek için bir ağaç kangurusunun gözbebeği olmaya karar verir.

episodes.name: İdeal Bekar Yaşamı
episodes.description: Panda kendi başına yaşayan bir rüya hayatı hayal eder. Beklentilerini karşılayan bir yer bulmaya çalışan Panda, Penguen ile birlikte diğer hayvanların nerede yaşadığını kontrol eder.

episodes.name: Yaz Festivali
episodes.description: Kutup Ayısı ve Grizzly, Pandanın bir akrabası olan Küçük Pandanın katıldığı bir yaz festivalinde birlikte bir stand düzenlerler. Her şeyi sattıktan sonra, çete festivalin manzaralarının tadını çıkarır.

episodes.name: Panda Is No Longer a Panda
episodes.description: Panda is reassigned to one part of the zoo after another — even serving as a zookeeper.

episodes.name: Mei Mei's Prince
episodes.description: Panda's sister Mei Mei goes on about her crush on Mr Handa. However, after seeing Handa and Ms Badger at a realty office, Panda believes that the two are getting married.

episodes.name: Sales Penguin
episodes.description: The trio of Pygoscelis penguins from the water park try to figure out how to sell their excess of penguin cards, eventually settling on creating a concentration game with them, which becomes a hit.

episodes.name: Bay Penguen'in Pikniği
episodes.description: Penguen sonunda tüm Penko kız kardeşlerle eşit olarak çıkmak zorunda kalır, ancak yine de onları ayırt etmekte güçlük çeker. Sasako, kız kardeşlere onları daha iyi tanımak için farklı renkte kurdeleler vermesini önerir, ancak birbirleriyle takas etmeye karar verdiklerinde geri teper.

episodes.name: Bay Handa'nın Tartışması
episodes.description: Bay Handa, Sasako'ya nasıl çıkma teklif edeceği konusunda tavsiye almak için Kutup Ayısı ile buluşur, ancak Kutup Ayısı, toplantının gerçekleştiği yemekle daha fazla ilgileniyor gibi görünmektedir. Bu arada, Sasako, Panda ve Penguin'i endişelendiren kafeye gelen birkaç yakışıklı erkeğe hizmet ediyor.

episodes.name: Panda Mama's Daily Life
episodes.description: Panda Mama goes to buy walnuts and learns the trick of stuffing the bag full from Mama Red Squirrel, and then endures a lecture from King Penguin Mama on how to eat at an all-you-can-eat cake buffet. The group then decides to eat at Polar Bear's Café, where they end up taxing his sanity.

episodes.name: Panda's Apprenticeship
episodes.description: Panda decides he wants to become someone's apprentice but is rather picky about who his master is. He eventually settles on becoming Sloth's apprentice, but quits due to not being able match his levels of laziness.

episodes.name: A Sports Day Filled with Animals
episodes.description: Polar Bear abruptly tasks Sasako with being the emcee of a sport competition for animals (in which Handa is the only human participant), while Panda Mama and Mama Red Squirrel quarrel over how to prepare rice balls.

episodes.name: Bay Penguen'in Hobileri
episodes.description: Penguen bir sanat sergisi açar, ancak resimlerin hiçbiri orijinal değildir ve müşteriler tarafından beğenilmemiştir. Kutup Ayısı ve Panda sergiyi gördükten sonra, onlar ve Penguen onların ve diğer kafe müdavimlerinin ne gibi hobileri olduğunu tartışırlar.

episodes.name: Their Childhood Days
episodes.description: As Polar Bear gets Grizzly to help out with a few things, he tells about how they first met.

episodes.name: Yeni Panda
episodes.description: Tam Zamanlı Panda ek bir işe girerken, geçici bir Pandanın hayvanat bahçesine geleceğini öğrendiğinde, yerinin değiştirilebileceğini hissederek endişelenmeye başlar. Temp Panda geldiğinde ve diğer pandalara karşı oldukça sert davrandığında, merkez pandanın kim olması gerektiği konusunda bir oylama yapılır.

episodes.name: Grizzly Barda Buluşma
episodes.description: Grizzly Barda bir Kaplan, Kurt ve Aslan küçük bir araya gelir. Eskiden rap sanatçısı olan Kutup Ayısı, gençliklerini nasıl kaybettiklerine üzülürken onlara sürpriz bir performans hediye eder.

episodes.name: Animal Field Baseball
episodes.description: The zoo animals from the Polar Bear's Cafe and the wild animals from Grizzly's bar face off against each other in a baseball match.

episodes.name: What's Jacu Coffee!?
episodes.description: The Red Squirrels teach Misaki about how coffee changes taste depending on how much it has been roasted.

episodes.name: Panda's Apology
episodes.description: Polar Bear attempts to fill in for Panda but is questioned by the police. As way of apologise, Panda decides to give Polar Bear a day off by working at the cafe, though it's not as easy as he thinks.

episodes.name: RinRin Is Invited
episodes.description: RinRin is invited out drinking by Full Time Panda, who is curious as to why he considers Panda to be cute but not him.

episodes.name: Panda's New Part Time Job
episodes.description: Panda goes through various part time jobs, including a car dealership, a stock marketer and a lecturer, where he somehow manages to make the respective companies successful and even become a CEO.

episodes.name: Mr. Penguin Goes Flying
episodes.description: Penguin has aspirations of flight so the others try various attempts to get him airborne.

episodes.name: Halloween
episodes.description: Polar Bear, Panda and Penguin go trick or treating on Halloween, getting some curious treats from the homes they visit.

episodes.name: Llama Day
episodes.description: Tired of being passed over all the time, Llama suggests the zoo should hold a Llama Day. However, the animals struggle with coming up with ideas to make Llama more appealing.

episodes.name: Mr. Penguin's Dilemma!
episodes.description: As Penguin is put under the pressure to choose one of the Penko sisters, Llama helps him to differentiate between them, but this soon backfires.

episodes.name: Idol: Yama Arashi!
episodes.description: Panda Mama goes with King Penguin Mama to a concert by porcupine pop group Yama Arashi.

episodes.name: The Café Garden
episodes.description: Polar Bear takes the others to see the café's garden where all the ingredients are grown.

episodes.name: Sales Penguin's Sales
episodes.description: The sales penguins attempt to pitch their penguin trading card game to Handa so they can sell it in the zoo's shop, even suggesting they hold a penguin themed hero show to attract customers.

episodes.name: Panda Corner's Contest / Coffee Roaster Masaki
episodes.description: Panda becomes depressed as the penguin hero show appears to take customers away from the panda corner. Rin-Rin suggests to Panda that the zoo put on a photo contest to attract more customers. Meanwhile, Masaki has a go at roasting coffee, learning the meaning behind hand picking coffee beans. Despite some initial interest in the photo contest, the panda corner is still overshadowed by the penguin show, which Penguin also participates in. Thus Polar Bear suggests the Panda family put on their own performance, which proves to be a big hit.

episodes.name: Wolf's Occupation Change
episodes.description: Wolf ends up quitting his job at a bakery, so Tiger recruits him for his sweets shops. After Wolf hears about a position at a famous bakery from Panda-Mama, Tiger encourages Wolf to go for it, and he manages to get the job.

episodes.name: Mr Penguin's New Love
episodes.description: The gang hear from Llama that Penguin has been visiting the neighbouring town's Brown Bear Cafe. As Polar Bear decides to check it out, he learns Penguin has gained a crush on the waitress penguin there, deciding not to come to Polar Bear's Cafe until he works up the courage to ask her out.

episodes.name: Sloth Wants to Work
episodes.description: Sloth starts working part-time at the cafe, though it doesn't prove easy with his speed.

episodes.name: Mr. Handa's Present
episodes.description: Handa asks for Polar Bear and Lesser Panda's help in figuring out what to get Sasako for Christmas.

episodes.name: Grizzly's Hibernation Preparations!
episodes.description: The pandas look for ways to hibernate at the zoo, but Handa calls them out on it. Grizzly takes Polar Bear shopping for a pillow to sleep on during hibernation.

episodes.name: Grizzly's Hibernation!
episodes.description: When Grizzly does get to hibernate, he is rudely interrupted by Polar Bear, who takes him to the driving range. When Panda and Penguin turn up, Grizzly, cranky from lack of sleep, takes them all out to a hot pot bistro.

episodes.name: Christmas Planning
episodes.description: Panda wonders whether he'll get a present for Christmas — until Rin Rin shows up with a knitted pochette for Panda, which the latter accepts reluctantly.

episodes.name: Christmas Trouble
episodes.description: Penguin, eager to show off his storytelling, tries in vain to find a party to appear at before deciding on Bar the Grizzly. Panda and Mei Mei argue over whose picture should be sent to Handa as a Christmas present, and Llama and Alpaca use their wool to create scarves and other garments.

episodes.name: Big Cleaning at the Café
episodes.description: Polar Bear ropes in everyone to do some spring cleaning around the cafe before Panda-Mama brings a salmon for everyone to have hotpot.

episodes.name: For Whom Does the Bell Toll?
episodes.description: Polar Bear, Panda, Penguin, Sasako and Llama spend New Year's Eve together, where they reminisce about the past year. They are soon joined by the other animals to see the New Year in.

episodes.name: The Animals' Hidden Talent Competition
episodes.description: As the New Year rolls in, the Polar Bear's Cafe holds a hidden talent contest.

episodes.name: New Year's Guest
episodes.description: Penguin comes to visit Panda's home whilst the cafe is closed, which doesn't please Panda very much.

episodes.name: The Hammock Sea
episodes.description: Polar Bear sets up a hammock in his garden and invites Panda and Penguin to laze around with him.

episodes.name: Panda Mama's Gardening
episodes.description: After Panda upsets Panda-Mama by eating her tulips, he tries and find something to replace them.

episodes.name: Scattering Beans with Everyone
episodes.description: The café holds a Setsubun event, where everyone takes turns being the ogre.

episodes.name: The Café in the Afternoon
episodes.description: Sasako and Llama reminisce about their elementary school days.

episodes.name: Polar Bear's Insomnia
episodes.description: The gang try and help Polar Bear as he has trouble sleeping due to insomnia.

episodes.name: Mr. Grizzly' First Love
episodes.description: Polar Bear and Grizzly think back to their high school days, where Grizzly had a crush on a girl Grizzly named Tsukiko.

episodes.name: Pun Café
episodes.description: Fed up with Polar Bear's annoying puns, Grizzly and Penguin try to get everyone in town to beat Polar Bear at his own game.

episodes.name: The Secret to Delicious Coffee
episodes.description: Masaki is told how coffee can taste different depending on how it's prepared, and wonders if he can win over the Red Squirrels with advice from Polar Bear.

episodes.name: Mr. Full-Time Panda, Mr. Llama and Rin Rin
episodes.description: Affter a long day at work, Mr. Full-time Panda and Mr. Llama decide to have a few drinks. They later invite Rin Rin, who takes the drunk Panda and Llama to Grizzly's bar, where everyone there gets drunk into the morning.

episodes.name: The Everyday Zoo
episodes.description: Panda is shocked to learn that Full-Time Panda has been transferred to a zoo in Singapore. He agrees to work full time until another panda is hired, causing some worry amongst his friends.

episodes.name: The Zoo in the Rain
episodes.description: When a Valentine's couple end up insulting Panda after two weeks of straight work, Penguin stands up against them. Panda soon cheers up after a new part-time panda is found and gives his thanks to Penguin.

episodes.name: Rin Rin and Mei Mei's Super Exciting Plan
episodes.description: Rin Rin and Mei Mei find they have some common interests and work together to think of a plan to get closer to Panda and Handa. However, Rin Rin ends up catching a fever, so Mei Mei decides to instead look after him.

episodes.name: Smelt Fishing
episodes.description: Polar Bear and the others go to the frozen lakes to do some smelt fishing, though soon get distracted. After Grizzly helps to catch a whole bunch, Polar Bear sets up an igloo cafe to make use of their ingredients.

episodes.name: Doll Festival
episodes.description: The younger penguins set up a display for Hina Matsuri, which goes a little awry when the cafe-goers make their own contributions. Grizzly is called in to help them set it up, only to realize that, besides Sasako, there are no girls around to celebrate it.

episodes.name: The Animal Doctor
episodes.description: Polar Bear develops a fever and goes to the animal hospital for some medicine. Panda and Penguin decide to come over to look after him, only to end up catching fevers themselves.

episodes.name: South Pole Squad Penguinger
episodes.description: The Pygoscelis Penguins are approached by a TV studio to do a televised version of South Pole Squad Penginger alongside Yama Arashi, with some of the other animals making cameos.

episodes.name: Even More, What Is Roasting?
episodes.description: Polar Bear teaches Masaki how a coffee's richness differs based on how it is prepared. He later learns Tree Kangaroo will let him start roasting his own coffee beans.

episodes.name: Sloth's Trip
episodes.description: Panda and the others end up joining Sloth on a long walk to the hot springs, wanting to get their on his own two feet.

episodes.name: I Became a Doll
episodes.description: The group become paper dolls as they converse in the real world.

episodes.name: White Day
episodes.description: Handa tries to figure out what to get Sasako for White Day.

episodes.name: Mr. Grizzly's Reunion
episodes.description: Grizzly is visited by his mother, who embarrasses him a little when she starts serving home cooking in his bar. After trying it for himself, however, it soon turns out to be a big hit.

episodes.name: Mr. Llama's Time Capsule
episodes.description: Llama, Sasako and the others visit their hometown to find a time capsule Llama buried five years ago. Upon arriving, however, they discover the tree he buried it under is in the middle of a private property.

episodes.name: Mr. Peguin's Secret
episodes.description: Panda becomes curious about what Penguin does when he's not at the cafe.

episodes.name: Cherry Blossom Viewing in Spring
episodes.description: Polar Bear becomes downhearted when Penguin expresses interest in moving house, though feels relieved once he hears he just intends to renew his apartment lease. Afterwards, everyone gathers around to have a cherry blossom viewing party, looking back on the year they've spent together.
